name: AltLayer
rootCause: AltLayer, a temporary extension layer built on Optimistic Rollups, tweeted that early this morning, its Twitter profile was not displaying past tweets on the timeline. After approximately 3 hours of handling, the account has now been restored to normal. The entire incident may have been an organized attack. AltLayer advises users to stay safe and cross-check any information and links across multiple channels.
